Vacancy for Dr Sushila Nayar Hospital Utavali, Dharni
Saturday, 20 July 2024
3325 Hits
The Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS) invites applications for the following posts for Dr. Sushila Nayar Hospital, Utavali, Dharni (a 50 beded Hospital in Tribal area of Dharni, Melghat) with the prescribed proforma (
Available here
) along with the certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates should reach to the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram, Dist. Wardha (MS)- 442102, Maharashtra latest by 10/08/2024.
Gynaecologist - (1)
Paediatrician - (1)
Anaesthesiologist - (1)
General Duty Medical Officer - (1)
Required Qualification:
1 to 3: MBBS with NMC recognized Post-graduate Degree/Diploma in concerned subject. For 4: MBBS.
Candidates with previous experience of working in Hospital, Out patient, Inpatient departments, M.J.F.J.A.Y. scheme and Community Health Services will be preferred.
Salary:
As per Rules of Kasturba Health Society.
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
